candidates.violated_requirement: After a non-matching group (sf6 state), the next state transition for the first bit of the next group is incorrectly swapped. When data=1, it should go to sf1 (continue mismatch path), but instead goes to s1 (start match path). This will cause incorrect sequence detection for groups following a non-match.
candidates.spec_basis: The specification requires that sequence detection begins fresh with each new group of six bits, without overlapping or reusing bits between groups. A non-matching group should not affect the detection of subsequent groups.
